name: Whirlpool Modular Ice Maker Mold Heater (L–H)
purpose: 2225623 service sheet — mold heater 185 W @ 120 V = 72 Ω at test points L–H (module on support).
failureModes: Open L–H — no harvest heat (IM E3 heater timeout on test 56)
Out of band — wrong module or partial short
testingTips: Power off; ejector blades in park; heater attached to support
Live: L–H line voltage = heater ON; 0 V = OFF

name: Whirlpool Modular Ice Maker Motor (L–M)
purpose: 2225623 — ejector motor 8800 Ω at L–M with motor disconnected from support.
failureModes: Open winding — no harvest (IM E2 motor home not found)
Motor runs but no eject — module cam or blade coupling
testingTips: Disconnect motor from support before ohm test
Live: L–M line voltage = motor ON during cycle

name: Whirlpool Modular Ice Maker Bimetal (cold)
purpose: Module bimetal closes ≤17°F ±3°; opens 32°F ±3° — harvest thermostat.
failureModes: Stuck open when cold — no harvest cycle
testingTips: Powered: T–H 0 V = closed; line voltage = open

name: Whirlpool Modular Ice Maker Harness Thermal Fuse
purpose: In-harness fuse opens if mold heater overheats — dead ice maker until harness replaced.
failureModes: OL — fuse blown after mold heater fault
Replace harness; verify L–H heater after event
testingTips: Ice maker unplugged from cabinet; ohm fuse in harness (often black wire)
